newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Stanley warrants on European paper basket.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley warrants on European paper basket.

text.p: Morgan Stanley (Jersey) Ltd has issued 15 million American-style call warrants, in three equal tranches, on a European paper basket comprising UPM Kyummene, Enso, Stora, MoDo and Norske Skog, joint lead managers Morgan Stanley & Co International Ltd and Morgan Stanley Bank said.
